# PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati (ATS Tekno)

> PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati (ATS Tekno) is an authorized distributor, electrical wholesaler, and certified switchboard panel manufacturer based in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia.

## Company & Geographic Overview
- **Legal Entity**: PT. Anugerah Tama Sejati (ATS Tekno)
- **Head Office & Central Warehouse**: Ruko Galaxi Bumi Permai J-1 No. 23, Sukolilo, Surabaya, Jawa Timur 60134, Indonesia
- **Coordinates**: -7.250445, 112.768845
- **Showrooms**: Jl. Jagalan No. 38 (Surabaya) & The Taman Dayu (Pandaan, Pasuruan)
- **Contact**: Phone (031) 59178887, WhatsApp 0822-2333-2830, Email: sales@atstekno.com
- **Tax & Compliance**: Official registered Indonesian company (Faktur Pajak PPN 11%, ISO 9001 certified processes)
- **Website**: https://atstekno.com

## Authorized Distribution Partnerships
- **Schneider Electric**: Authorized Dealer & Distributor (MCB, MCCB, ACB, TeSys Contactors, Altivar VFDs, AvatarOn)
- **Legrand Indonesia**: Authorized Distributor (Plexo enclosures, industrial wiring devices, cable management)
- **Supreme Cable (SUCACO)**: Official Supplier (NYA, NYM, NYY, NYFGBY, FRC cables)
- **GAE Group**: Authorized Distributor (Digital power meters, energy analyzers, capacitor banks)
- **Vinsa**: Official Partner (Industrial wall-mounting & free-standing electrical enclosures)

## Product Catalog & Technical Specifications
Every product page on ATS Tekno provides complete technical parameters (rated current, breaking capacity, operating voltage, pole count, dimensions, IEC/SNI standards), ready stock availability in Surabaya, and verified procurement guidelines:
- [Product Catalog](https://atstekno.com/products): Browse electrical components with live search, brand filters, and full datasheets.
- [Brand Price Lists](https://atstekno.com/price-list): Official catalog price lists with PDF downloads.

## Certified Switchboard Panel Manufacturing
ATS Tekno operates a full-scale in-house manufacturing workshop in Surabaya with an end-to-end 33-stage production workflow:
- [Panel Building Process](https://atstekno.com/panel-building-process): 33-step industrial switchboard manufacturing process including fiber laser cutting, CNC bending, multi-stage chemical pretreatment (degreasing, pickling, phosphating), electrostatic powder coating, copper busbar processing, electrical wiring, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) compliant with IEC 61439-1/2.
- Types of switchboards built: LVMDP (Low Voltage Main Distribution Panel), Sub-Distribution Panels (SDP), Motor Control Centers (MCC), Capacitor Banks, ATS-AMF (Automatic Transfer Switch).
